defective_pattern: Forcing multidimensional opposing constructs (e.g., ERQ_R and ERQ_S) into a single 2-indicator latent factor without local identification, suppressing R warnings with options(warn = -1), and ignoring non-invertible information matrices, negative variances, and standardized betas > 1.0.
why_defective: Causes Heywood cases (negative variances or out-of-bound parameters), resulting in statistically invalid inferences. Suppressing warnings hides critical failure states.
observed_symptoms: lavaan warning: some estimated ov variances are negative
lavaan warning: covariance matrix of latent variables is not positive definite
standardized loadings or betas exceeding 1.0 or less than -1.0
use of options(warn = -1) in SEM R scripts
corrective_remedy: Never suppress R warnings. Verify local identification (e.g., fixing parameters or adding indicators). Model multidimensional scales correctly. Enforce a mathematical admissibility gate before reporting results.

detection_heuristic.trigger_rule: Detection of 'options(warn = -1)' in SEM scripts or standardized outputs with absolute values > 1.0.
